# dsh-enter-guard
Double-Enter send guard for **DeepSeek Harness**. The first `Enter` only *arms* the composer — nothi
ng is sent. The second `Enter` sends. Pressing any other key cancels.
Stops a half-written message from being sent by an accidental Enter.

[代码示例省略，未执行]
## The gap it fills
DeepSeek Harness sends on `Enter` and has no confirmation step. Its only setting (`Settings → Genera
l → Enter behavior`) decides whether `Enter` **queues** or **steers** while the agent is busy — it d
oes nothing about accidental sends when the agent is idle.
A community catalog scan (6084 DSH plugins) turns up nothing in this category. The closest neighbour
s only cover half the problem: `dsh-prompt-stash` stashes a draft on demand, `dsh-composer-plus` enh
ances the built-in queue, `dsh-sleep-send` adds scheduled sending, and the `prompt-refine` family re
writes the draft *before* sending — none of them intercept the Enter key.
## Behaviour
| Situation | Result |
| First `Enter` (no modifier, not IME-composing, not key-repeat) | **blocked** — composer outlined,

hint shown |
| `Enter` while armed | passes through — DSH sends natively |
| **Any** other key while
armed (letters, digits, Backspace, arrows, Shift, Ctrl, Alt, Win, CapsLock) | state cancelled immed

iately |
| Draft changed, IME composition start, blur, click outside | state cancelled |
| `Ctrl`/`C

md`+`Enter`, clicking Send | **sends immediately**, no confirmation (deliberate escape hatch) |
| `/

` command menu or `@` file menu open | passes through — Enter there selects a candidate |
| Holding

`Enter` down (key repeat) | ignored, never sends by itself |
| Empty draft (no text, no attachment)

| not intercepted |
| 2 seconds after arming | hint fades, **state is kept** — a later `Enter` still

tercepted |
| 2 seconds after arming | hint fades, **state is kept** — a later `Enter` still sends |

## Compatibility
Anchors come from the DSH web client (`dsh-client-ui-conversation`):
| Selector | Purpose |

| `[data-composer-card]` | composer card (outline + hint anchor) |
| `[data-composer-input]` | edita

ble area (focus / emptiness check) |
| `[data-trigger-menu]` | command & file candidate menu (pass-t

hrough) |
| `[data-composer-chip]` | attachment / reference chips (counts as content) |
If a future DSH release renames these, the plugin **fails safe**: it becomes a no-op and native `Ent
er` behaviour is restored. It never swallows a message. A startup self-check warns in the console 5
s after boot when the anchor is missing.
Tested against DSH **0.1.5-rc.3** on Windows / Chrome.
## Known limitations

1. **Enter only.** The Send button and `Ctrl`/`Cmd`+`Enter` always send immediately — by design.
2.
**Cannot stop plugins that call `submit()` directly.** Voice-input plugins that auto-send bypass the

keyboard entirely.
3. **DOM-anchor dependent** (see above).
4. **Not verified on mobile virtual key

boards** — they may not emit `keydown`.
5. One composer card is assumed (the first match). Normal si
ngle-session UI is unaffected.
## Design note
The guard deliberately **does not clear the draft, does not call `setDraft`, does not touch the atta
chment pipeline**. The text simply stays in the composer and is sent later. That is why the whole fe
ature fits in a read-only DOM listener and why it is safe to remove at any time.
## Testing
Two zero-dependency Node harnesses (fake DOM, no browser, no DSH involved):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
These live in the parent directory of this package (the development workspace), not in the published
e in the parent directory of this package (the development workspace), not in the published tarball.
Manual regression before trusting it — six checks:

1. `/` opens the command menu → `Enter` **selects** a candidate
2. `@` opens the file menu → `Enter`

**inserts** the reference
3. `Shift`+`Enter` → inserts a **newline**, no outline
4. `Ctrl`+`Enter`

→ **sends immediately**
5. Agent busy + `Enter` → still queues / steers as configured
6. Paste an im
age, then `Enter` → attachment **is sent with the message**
## Security
Read-only DOM. A single document-level `keydown`/`input`/`compositionstart`/`focusout`/`click` liste
ner set, one injected `<style>`, one floating hint `<div>`.

- no `fetch`, no `XMLHttpRequest`, no `WebSocket`
- no `localStorage`, no `sessionStorage`, no cooki

es
- no session data, no settings writes, no host-side code (the host half is an empty shell)
- all
decision code is wrapped in `try/catch` and **fails open** — an internal error restores native behav
iour instead of eating the key
